description: Use this to learn how a buyer behaves before bidding: what it awarded, to which suppliers, how many bidders its tenders draw (median_bidders, single_bidder_share) and how awards compare with the estimate (median_award_to_estimate). Pass tender_id from search_tenders, or buyer_name, or buyer_id. Built from the buyer's awarded tenders in Open Contracting (OCDS) data; period, sources and computed_at are in each match. An empty matches list comes with a note saying why. Access: needs an identified agent key (free, self-service at https://pass.andesprotocol.com).
name: buyer_history
title: Buyer history
